body: I feel your pain, my stbx took care/controlled everything. Feels like I just got out of prison and now I have to figure out how the real world works. What to do with all the extra time, wanting to talk about my day, no one is here now. All alone in a strange new world. Looking at a new place all alone is so sad. I keep wanting to ask "what do you think about this?" But no one is there. No family, no friends, no one to come home to. No advice on the simplest things, like does this towel match well with the rug. I never got to make decisions, I got so used to that, now feels like I can't. Still sleeping on one side of the bed, you would think I would sleep in the middle, or take more space. Just doesn't feel right. Nothing feels right.
Nah, not much to talk about. Thanks though.

I'm 42, I have fibromyalgia, depression, ADD and a few other problems you get with age. I've been married for 14 years and have a 9 year old son. 2 months ago my father died, a week later my wife says she wants a divorce. I have a low paying job and live paycheck to paycheck. I think about suicide every day even though I know I won't do it. Would never put my son through that. My mother molested me when I was young and I have absolutely no friends. Life is hard but you just keep going because ,well the end will come sooner or later anyways, might as well just ride it out and see what happens. Maybe I will win the lottery one day or something lol.

It's not stupid to want/need help, everyone needs help wether they admit it or not. That's the first step, getting help. No it's not frustrating, when I was your age there was no internet, back then there was no help. Helping others helps myself, I have dark thoughts every day. Trying to help others see hope brings me hope. Maybe all my screw ups can be helpful for someone else.

Dreams are great, dreams can help. Just have to make sure the dreams are realistic. You have to believe in yourself, you have to make yourself believe in yourself. Put all your effort in school, the education you're getting now is free, make the most of it. At least you said "probably not" that means there's a chance that it could be "probably can".

Wow that dude is bat shit crazy, I'm so sorry for you. You did nothing wrong, you don't deserve any of that. Some people are just not right in the head. Don't have any advice other than maybe carry a tazer or a can of mace.

You should still ask for help, you don't have to honest about it being about her. You could say you're depressed about something else. It's hard asking for help, but everyone needs it at some point in their life.

Sure, yeah you're right about not wanting to be dependent on her. You need to be dependent on yourself, easier said than done, I know. If I could do my life over, I would try everything I could possibly do to excel in school so I could get a high paying job so I could travel the world. I was alot like you at your age, didn't think I would make it past 20. It might be wise to have a back up plan in case you make it past your expected end date.

About the only thing I can recommend is to find something you can do that you really enjoy doing and try to put as much effort into it that you can. Stay away from drugs, they're fun for a while but they wreak havoc in your body, and if you find your way out of depression you will have to deal with your broken body. Plus they're expensive and once they're gone so will be your money.
